crons.description: Hourly Payment Voucher SLA engine: overdue PV / actions scan, responsible + partner escalation, next_notify_at 2-hour digest.
Hourly Case Bottleneck Monitor (h+30): no_movement / waiting / on_hold / pv_delay / approval_waiting + explicit severity escalations. Separate advisory lock from PV engine (G18 engine independence).
Hourly notification digest (h+15): bumps delivery_count + last_notified_at when next_notify_at <= now (2-hour repeat default for escalations). No external channel (Email Inbox DEFERRED_BY_USER §23).
